source_refs.note: Topic 2.5.1.4 Keyword Arguments (PDF 47, printed 44). The printed string lacks spaces ('and I am' joins); the lesson adds them.

blocks.title: Keyword arguments
blocks.text: Functions can be called with keyword arguments, naming each parameter, which makes calls more readable and lets arguments be given in any order.

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)

blocks.text: Output: My name is Ali and I am 20 years old. str(age) turns the number into text so it can be joined to the other strings.
